facts.fact: UNHCR states that 13,628 refugees were registered with biometric data collected by the national refugee commission (CNCR) with UNHCR support in October-December 2025, and that 10,345 refugees in Mali remain unregistered, out of 276,698 (government, CNCR).

facts.fact: UNHCR Mali reports 135,538 refugees registered by 31 March 2025 and 5,924 refugee certificates and identity cards distributed in January-March 2025.
UNHCR says biometric registration has been suspended indefinitely after the January 2025 US funding suspension, leaving 64,315 asylum-seekers without formal status.

UNHCR Mali reports that as of April 2024 1,031 households of 2,347 individuals were registered and 1,031 refugee certificates were issued to households by the National Commission in Charge of Refugees (CNCR), after a registration operation launched in February 2024 with the CNCR.
